text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: While "shining ones" exist in great numbers—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Opera O's brilliance back then
was truly worthy of the pinnacle of an era.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...The me of another world ran the Takarazuka Kinen
twice alongside Opera O."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
In his first year, he was already demonstrating overwhelming strength,
as if to build an era worthy of an Overlord.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "And then, in the Takarazuka Kinen, he defeated Grass, who had been considered the strongest, proudly heralding the dawn of his own era."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: "...Come to think of it, that was when the fateful rivalry between Doto and Opera O began too."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
After that, including the first 'Takarazuka Kinen,'
Doto finished in second place behind Opera O in five GⅠ races.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Can you believe it? In GⅠ races, the exact same pair took first and second a whole five times.
Even across all "records", there are no other numbers like that.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
—...And so arrived
the second Takarazuka Kinen against Opera O and the others.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: In their sixth showdown, Doto finally triumphed over Opera O. ...She proved her unyielding spirit to the whole world.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The me of another world bore witness across two Takarazuka Kinens to Opera O's reign and Doto's rebellion.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Strangely enough, both finished in 4th place.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Today's Takarazuka Kinen.
Whatever Opera O and Doto are feeling inside is beyond measure, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...This is my journey.
This is our Takarazuka Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Just watching their rivalry unfold would be a total waste, right?
choice_data_list: Let's go create a rivalry, starting with you.
Let's create a rivalry from your side.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOOOOOOOAAAHH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Attention, everyone!
Splendid of you all to gather on this fateful day!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "You shall witness it. Like Radames' Triumphal March—the glorious moment of the Supreme Ruler's reign!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, let us run! And rejoice!!
At the beginning of a legend that will be sung of far into the future!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Opera O-san.
Today, I...――

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'll run...
as your rival...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: —How flashy.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Thinking you're the Supreme Overlord already?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Oh my—
That's not like you. You understand, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Reigning supreme is merely a formality.
For I am the Overlord! And have been for a very long time.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Time and destiny are in love with me.
Shall we prove that today?!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Haha.
That's more like it."

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: (Opera O. In my "memories," you were the one who stood at the "center of the era" the longest—the very thing I aim for now. That's why—)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I'll perform for you on your stage.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
A trickster... who smashes through
whatever you call destiny.
